name: wows-omp-plugin-judge-dispatch
description: Route OMP subagent types with native judge-role judgments

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum native judgment confidence required to change an agent type

includeSharedContext.description: Include the task call's shared context in the routing judgment

judgeEffort.description: Also let the judge set each task call's thinking effort (lo/med/hi), replacing the requested one

modelBudget.description: Pick each task spawn's model from its configured chain by judged difficulty, catalog intelligence score, and price
